frases: What if your {show notas}notes turned into [+videos] like this one?
Scroll to study turns {show ar}your material into {show vid}short videos, with voice.
To understand a {show pr}[+project], or to study for an {show ex}exam.

elementos.text: not found → not in the video

frases: But can you [+trust] it? Every fact is checked against your material.
Claude writes each {show af}statement with a {show cit}verbatim quote and its source.
A {show con}{type con}script checks that the quote, the names and the numbers are there.
Whatever cannot be checked does {show out}[-not] reach the video.

elementos.title: Claude Code
msgs: Make me scroll to study videos from my notes.

frases: To use it, open Claude Code in the folder of your notes, and {show ch}[+ask].
Claude {show vos}stops so you decide {show tm}{good tm +0.3}the topics,
and, in a project, {show dud}{good dud +0.3}which doubtful facts are true. It does the rest by itself.
Each video is {show html}a single file of about one megabyte,
and it plays {show off}{boom off +0.2}[+offline], even on your phone.
In [+short]: {show fl1}your material becomes videos, {show fl2}and every fact is checked.
{show fnext}Next: try it with your own notes.
